diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 671d1e6..bc3a5bd 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+tmux (3.6a-2ubuntu0.2) resolute; urgency=medium
+

 tmux (3.6a-2ubuntu0.1) resolute-security; urgency=medium
 
   * SECURITY UPDATE: use after free in image_free
diff --git a/debian/patches/lp2169164-uninitialized-notify.patch b/debian/patches/lp2169164-uninitialized-notify.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7da0ab2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/lp2169164-uninitialized-notify.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+From e5a2a25fafb8ee107c230d8acad694f6b635f8bb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: nicm <nicm>
+Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 09:35:20 +0000
+Subject: [PATCH] Do not notify clients if not fully initialized, from Ben
+ Maurer in GitHub issue 4980.
+Origin: upstream https://github.com/tmux/tmux/commit/e5a2a25fafb8ee107c230d8acad694f6b635f8bb.patch
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/tmux/+bug/2169164
+---
+ control-notify.c | 3 ++-
+ 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
+
+diff --git a/control-notify.c b/control-notify.c
+index ba6a8355cf..0ced0c87f5 100644
+--- a/control-notify.c
++++ b/control-notify.c
+@@ -24,7 +24,8 @@
+ #include "tmux.h"
+ 
+ #define CONTROL_SHOULD_NOTIFY_CLIENT(c) \
+-	((c) != NULL && ((c)->flags & CLIENT_CONTROL))
++	((c) != NULL && ((c)->flags & CLIENT_CONTROL) && \
++	 (c)->control_state != NULL)
+ 
+ void
+ control_notify_pane_mode_changed(int pane)
+
diff --git a/debian/patches/series b/debian/patches/series
index 1da839f..7be0244 100644
--- a/debian/patches/series
+++ b/debian/patches/series
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
 platform-quirks.diff
 
 CVE-2026-11623.patch
+lp2169164-uninitialized-notify.patch
